```{r call-libraries} 
library(Giotto)
library(future); if(parallelly::availableCores() > 2 & .Platform$OS.type == "windows")  
  {plan('multisession', workers = parallelly::availableCores()-2)}
options(future.globals.maxSize= 1e12)
library(scran); library(MAST); library(leiden);   # library(multinet);  
library(data.table)
library(gplots); library(ggplot2); library(viridis)
library(dbscan)
library(dplyr); library(leidenAlg)
set.seed(43)
sessionInfo()
```

```{r read-in-L2annot}
sln <- readRDS("sln.L2annot.RDS")
plots = list()
prox.results = list()
```

```{r cellProximityEnrichment}
md <- pDataDT(sln)
list_ID <- unique(md$list_ID)
gc()

for (i in list_ID)
{
  print(i)
  keepCells <- subset(md, list_ID %in% i )$cell_ID
  sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = keepCells)
  sln.sm <- createSpatialKNNnetwork(sln.sm) 
  
  prox.results[i] <- cellProximityEnrichment(sln.sm, cluster_column = 'L1.annot', adjust_method = "fdr",
                                      number_of_simulations = 200, spatial_network_name = "knn_network")
  # Barplot depicting the ratio of observed over expected frequencies of pairwise interacting clusters (left). Barplot showing the total number of interactions between each pair (right).
  
  plots[i] <- cellProximityBarplot(sln.sm, CPscore = cellprox,  min_orig_ints = 3, min_sim_ints = 3, return_plot = T)
}

```





```{r Interaction-changed-genes}
gene_metadata = fDataDT(sln.sm)

high_expressed_genes = gene_metadata[mean_expr_det > quantile(gene_metadata$mean_expr_det)[4]]$gene_ID

## identify genes that are associated with proximity to other cell types
ICGscoresHighGenes = findInteractionChangedFeats(gobject = sln.sm, selected_feats = high_expressed_genes,
                                                 spatial_network_name = "knn_network", cluster_column = 'L1.annot',
                                                 diff_test = 'permutation', adjust_method = 'fdr', 
                                                 nr_permutations = 20, do_parallel = FALSE)
## visualize
plotCellProximityGenes(sln.sm, cpgObject = ICGscoresHighGenes, method = 'dotplot')
```
